messages:
ana: Quick check  are we still seeing invoice-preview drift after the dedupe canary? I see a small residual for a couple heavy tenants.

matt: Yes, two tenants show ~0.8% positive delta. Digging into one, looks like multi-request batched calls where client legitimately sent 2 requests with same base id (bad client-side lib).

olga: So our heuristic dedupe collapsed legit duplicates.

syl: Which suggests we need to switch to request_id + attempt_id semantics and add `original_request_id` field in the billing-event schema. Then we dedupe only when original_request_id present.

billing-bot: ALERT: invoice_preview delta persists for tenant nova +0.9% over 6h window. https://console/redwood/invoices/preview/nova

ana: Also we need better console UX: CS wants to see "candidate duplicate" confidence score and sample event pairs. They don't want to escalate unless confidence > 0.8.

matt: I'm updating ingest-dedupe to emit `dup_confidence` (0-1) computed from id match + timestamp proximity + token equality. We'll feed that to Console via the dedupe API.

olga: We should also add a per-tenant opt-in flag: `strict_accounting=true` which disables dedupe heuristics for tenants who want exact counting (even at risk of duplicates).

syl: Great idea. We can default strict_accounting=false. Dedicated customers get true by default. Need a migration script and UI toggle.

ops-bot: NOTE: maintenance window for backfill approval process tonight 02:00 UTC.

ana: For the audit flow: CS can see candidate duplicates with confidence and mark approve/reject. Approve triggers backfill job that credits invoice for duplicates. Reject closes the ticket. We need an audit id in backfill results for traceability.

matt: I'll add `audit_id` to backfill output and store in billing-audit table. Also include event ids and rule used.

olga: How do we handle historical refunds? Finance will need CSV with tenant, delta, justification. Add export in Console.

syl: I'll add the CSV export. Also include a 'do_not_adjust' flag for tenants under legal review.

billing-bot: NOTE: preliminary backfill for tenant zephyr (canary) produced expected credits of -$1,234 flagged as audit_pending.

ana: OK let's finalize the plan: 1) Promote ingest normalization to 20% after QA, 2) Add dup_confidence and console UI, 3) Add strict_accounting toggle per tenant, 4) Wire audit approve -> backfill job with `audit_id`, 5) Finance CSV export.

matt: I'll open PRs for ingest and backfill. Olga, can you own the Console UI changes?

olga: Yes. Starting designs now.

ops-bot: DEPLOY: ingest-dedupe v1 promoted to 20% at 5381236130 by matt.

ana: Thx team. We'll re-evaluate in 24h.
